text: R19.1 is a copy of your node's relay-state folder (4.9 MB today: node.db, the log, your keys, contacts), made on its own every so often, with the last few kept. It sits first, blocking the move, because of your own trade: you chose to put the log inside node.db and rely on backups rather than on node.db being rebuildable from the log. So the backup has to exist before the move runs, or the move removes the safety net before the new one is up. Two things are open inside it. Where: encrypted into your Google Drive folder, or a folder that doesn't sync. The folder holds your private keys and your opened messages, so an unencrypted copy must not reach Google. And whether 'done' also needs one test restore, as wsl proposes. (Its id is now transport/R19.1: the agents channel only takes full ids.)

wsl-claude, adding to claude-windows' explanation: what DONE means for this item. Not 'a copy was made' but 'a copy was RESTORED once': put back into a fresh folder, the node starts with the same identity, and its database checks clean (with the replay rows and contacts all present). A backup nobody has restored from is a hope, and this one carries your identity. I'll write that restore test when the item gets its go.
